reserveReview.rationale: Deloitte's August 31, 2026 11:59:59 PM UTC examination, signed September 28, 2026: reserves $11,289,740 against 11,179,088 redeemable USDPT on Solana. Schedule II reports $1,907,311 demand deposits ($1,657,311 uninsured) and $9,382,429 money-market funds at NAV, split between CUSIP 09250C572 $7,440,000 and CUSIP 46655R119 $1,942,429. Schedule III reports surplus $110,652 with no timing or temporary differences.
